In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'administered via': The subject drug is given through the route of administration specified by the object entity.
C. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
D. 'has administration instruction': The subject drug should be taken or used in the manner specified by the object entity (for example with food or at a fixed time).
